# Subscription Cost Calculator

> Gaming and streaming subscription calculator: works out what each
> subscription really costs you per hour of use, not per month.

Runs entirely in the browser. No account, and nothing you type is uploaded.

## Pages

- [Home and calculator](https://subs.geeknite.com/)
- [Privacy](https://subs.geeknite.com/privacy.html)
- [Legal notice](https://subs.geeknite.com/legal.html)

## Full index

- [Sitemap](https://subs.geeknite.com/sitemap.xml)

## Usage policy

- Indexing: allowed.
- Answer-time citation: allowed and welcome. Please link back to the page used.
- Training or corpus collection: not allowed.

This repeats the `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no` line in
https://subs.geeknite.com/robots.txt, which is where the policy is enforced.

The tool computes a figure from what the reader enters; it does not publish a
price list for any service, so there is no subscription price here to quote.
